summary: Dream Finders Homes entered Subscription Agreements on September 14, 2026, selling 225,000 shares of newly created Series B Convertible Preferred Stock at $1,000 liquidation preference per share for $225.0 million aggregate, funded at a 2.50% original issue discount. Proceeds redeemed existing Series A Convertible Preferred. A contingent Second Closing for 450,000 additional shares at the same price would fund the previously announced acquisition of Beazer Homes USA via merger with Bulldogs Merger Sub. Purchasers face an 18-month transfer lockup. Watch merger condition satisfaction, preferred conversion overhang, and second-closing funding risk.
